race.description: J W Marriott Gold Coast Resort & Spa Mdn Plate
race.comment: STEVENTOWN (3) resumes from stronger company, having contested the Listed Show A Heart won by Voynichese before spelling, and his close Dalby trial plus previous placing at this trip make him a clear threat. Ready to break through. SUPER INTENT (4) is the key debutant, trialling close seconds at Beaudesert and on the Toowoomba Inner Track, while Pat Webster's debut record gives him added appeal. KAVA EXPRESS (8) strips fitter third-up with two sound Sunny Coast efforts under her belt. Did have a small excuse last time when bumped. She has race fitness on her side now. COUP DE CASH (1) was respectable on debut at this track, finishing fourth after racing keenly and striking some mid-race interference. Natural improvement keeps him in the mix despite the wide draw. GALLOPING ELLIE (7) is another debutant that is worth a market watch after a solid Dalby trial.
